action.objective: Verify Bb5-d3 as the reserved top candidate by single-candidate search at depth 4.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search favored b5d3 (47) over a2a3/b2b4 (46, upper bounds). The reserved verification move is b5d3; it retreats the bishop to d3, keeping the light-squared bishop active and preparing castling. I use the reserved 2000-node allowance to search this move only, checking tactical safety and Black replies.
